items.title: Who's really going to buy Snap's Specs
items.summary: Payne Capital Management President & ‘Payne Points of Wealth’ Podcast Host Ryan Payne joins Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman and Jake Conley to discuss Snap's (SNAP) new Specs. The group debates who the target buyer is and what the real-world use case is for Snap’s latest product.

items.title: AI is the latest addiction — Does it need to be regulated like cigarettes?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) kicked off its Dreamforce 2026 conference this week, where the company unveiled its new AI-powered AIforce platform. Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff weighs in on how AI should be regulated, comparing the new technology to the addictive nature of cigarettes and social media on younger users.

items.title: Facebook Told Clark Howard a Deepfake Ad Stealing His Face Meets Their Standards
